_README: Provenance for the vendored CRD schemas in this directory. The files are byte-identical copies of the controller-gen output in nanohype/eks-agent-platform at the pinned ref below — never hand-edit them. `ref` is what makes the gate deterministic; the per-file `sha256` is what makes it tamper-evident. `npm run schemas:sync` rewrites both the copies and the digests from that ref; `npm run schemas:check` is the CI drift gate against the same ref. To adopt a newer operator API, bump `ref`, check that ref out, and re-run the sync.
